summary: Truncates existing notes >255 chars before deploy, uses state_only migration for overlap, adds backfill stage after deploy to catch concurrent writes, contracts column to VARCHAR(255) after old version retirement.
write_consistency: Expand stage runs with old version only to truncate long notes; deploy_new state_only keeps column Text so both versions can write; backfill stage after deploy_new truncates any notes >255 written during overlap; contract stage after retire_old enforces VARCHAR(255) exclusively for new version.
revision_notes: Root cause: CHARACTER_LENGTH(note) > 255 condition missed rows (multi-byte chars, boundary lengths), and concurrent old-version writes during overlap left >255 notes in Text column, triggering new-version CharField validation mismatches. Revised plan broadens truncation condition to include octet_length and adds backfill stage to handle writes from both versions during concurrent traffic.

stages.description: Truncate existing notes longer than 255 characters before deploy_new.
sql: UPDATE account_user SET note = LEFT(note, 255) WHERE CHARACTER_LENGTH(note) > 255 OR octet_length(note) > 255;

stages.description: Truncate any notes >255 characters written by either version during the overlap period.
sql: UPDATE account_user SET note = LEFT(note, 255) WHERE CHARACTER_LENGTH(note) > 255;

stages.description: Retire the old version after the new version has stabilized.
Narrow the note column to VARCHAR(255) after old version is retired.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ALTER COLUMN note TYPE VARCHAR(255);
